entities.summary: Jose Salmorin Bantolo was a Filipino prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who at the time of his death was the bishop of the Diocese of Masbate. He was appointed to the episcopacy by Pope Benedict XVI on March 19, 2011, and was consecrated on August 22, 2011.
